answer: At dawn, every identity plants one onyx vine cutting, and the k-th cutting costs ten times the k-th prime in onyx: the first pays 20, the second 30, the tenth 290, so ten identities pay 1,290 and a hundred pay 241,330, the hundredth alone 5,410. Vines fruit once a day, so the hundredth fake waits ninety-nine dawns and still pays the full 5,410 to sprout.
